**The window opens on the anchor and a short spine.** Column 0, `mcbA`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names 99% of them. Then columns 2 to 8, `ybiX` to `dinG`, are carried by 90 to 93%, all persistent, named 92 to 99.6%, fewest at column 5, `ybiE`, 92%.

Column 9, `ybiA`, is a fork, carried by 64%, with `espX2` at 13%. Through columns 41 to 44 a branch of 4 shell families runs in 11 to 14%, [[phage tail assembly]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 95 against 87%, and hesitates less there, 0.17 against 0.71 bits. It hesitates most at column 35, `ybhC`, a fork column, 1.86 bits.

**The window ends in the `sdh` genes.** Columns 76 to 79, `sdhB` to `sdhC`, are [[succinate dehydrogenase]]. The last column is `sdhC`, in 26% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 90% of genes**, 0.49 bits on average, perplexity 1.6 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.48 against 0.19 bits, and names fewer genes, 72% against 96%.

label: mcbA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the mcbA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor mcbA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,924 to 3,003 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying mcbA once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.49 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 31,272 calls, named 97%, 0.13 bits; shell 11,181 calls, named 75%, 1.31 bits; cloud 667 calls, named 7%, 3.83 bits. Outside an RGP 32,902 calls, named 96%, 0.19 bits; inside an RGP 10,218 calls, named 72%, 1.48 bits. Columns: 32 spine, 34 fork, 14 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.48 against 0.19 bits) and names fewer genes (72% against 96%); 10,218 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 35 (ybhC, a fork column) 1.86 bits, RGP 35%; column 36 (ybhJ, a fork column) 1.65 bits, RGP 70%; column 37 (ybhI, a fork column) 1.49 bits, RGP 81%. The 8 columns (columns 36-40 and 70-72) where most calls are in an RGP: named 82%, 1.09 bits on average; the other 72 columns: named 91%, 0.43 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 32 spine columns: named 95%, 0.17 bits on average; the 48 fork and variable columns: named 87%, 0.71 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 35, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: mcbA. named 99%; 0.07 bits.
[S2] 2. column 1 variable: share 88%, all P, RGP 0%. named 95%; 0.47 bits.
[S2.c1]    1: fiu P 88%
[S3] 3. columns 2-8 (7 columns) spine: share 90-93%, all P, RGP 0-0.2%. Genes: ybiX "PKHD-type hydroxylase YbiX", ybiI "C4-type zinc finger protein YbiI", ybiJ "DUF1471 family protein YbiJ", ybiE "protein YbiE", hcxB, ybiB "DNA-binding protein YbiB", dinG. named 92-99.6% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 5 (ybiE), named 92%, 0.79 bits.
[S4] 4. column 9 fork: share 64%, all S, RGP 1%. named 81%; 0.96 bits.
[S4.c9]    9: ybiA S 64% "N-glycosidase YbiA"; also espX2 S 13%
[S5] 5. columns 10-19 (10 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 0.2-1%. Genes: rhlE, cecR, hlyD, ybhF "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", ybhS "ABC transporter permease", ybhR "ABC transporter permease", ybhQ "YbhQ family protein", ybhP "endonuclease/exonuclease/phosphatas…", clsB, ybhN "lysylphosphatidylglycerol synthase…". named 60-99% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 15 (ybhR), named 60%; most hesitant at column 19 (ybhN), 0.43 bits.
[S6] 6. column 20 fork: share 75%, all S, RGP 1%. named 87%; 0.88 bits.
[S6.c20]    20: ybhM S 75% "Bax inhibitor-1/YccA family protein"; also "Bax inhibitor-1 family protein" S 10%
[S7] 7. columns 21-34 (14 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 0.2-7%. [S8] 8. columns 35-79 (45 columns) fork and variable columns: share 26-73%, 38 P, 7 S, RGP 31-83%. named 72-91% (mean 87%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 35, named 72%, 1.86 bits.
